Name: Auto Eat
Author: repeat26
Description:
[center][size=5]AutoEat[/size][/center]

[center]Automatically eat food when your health is low, and keep your buffs active all day.
血量过低时自动吃食物回血，增益消失自动补充 —— 让你专注游戏，不用管血条和状态。[/center]

[size=4]Features / 功能[/size]

[list]
[*]🩸 [b]Health auto-eat / 血量自动食用[/b] — eats when health falls below the threshold (default 30%)[/*]
[*]✨ [b]Buff auto-eat / 增益自动补充[/b] — keeps dish & drink buffs active all day[/*]
[*]🍽️ [b]Default foods / 默认食物[/b] — Cheese, Spicy Eel, Triple Shot Espresso ready out of the box[/*]
[*]⌨️ [b]Hotkeys / 快捷键[/b] — G (health), H (dish), J (drink) to designate food on the fly[/*]
[*]⭐ [b]Quality-smart / 品质优先[/b] — uses normal quality before silver, gold, iridium[/*]
[*]📋 [b]GMCM support / 游戏内配置[/b] — full in-game settings menu with three sections[/*]
[*]🌐 [b]Bilingual / 双语支持[/b] — English & 中文, follows your game language[/*]
[*]🔄 [b]Persistent / 持久记忆[/b] — your food choices survive restarts, no need to re-select[/*]
[*]🛡️ [b]Idle-safe / 不浪费[/b] — won't eat during cutscenes, menus, or when you're knocked out[/*]
[*]📢 [b]Depletion alerts / 耗尽提醒[/b] — tells you when food runs out without clearing your selection[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Default hotkeys / 默认快捷键[/size]


[table][tr][td]G[/td]
[td]Set health food / 设置回血食物[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]H[/td]
[td]Set buff dish / 设置增益菜品[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]J[/td]
[td]Set buff drink / 设置增益饮品[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[size=4]Requirements / 环境要求[/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional / 可选)[/*]
[/list]
